title: Production databases at capacity risk
description: For production databases, derive risk_reason by priority: `read_only` when read_only = 1; otherwise `disk` when free_percent < 15; otherwise `connections` when connections_used * 100.0 / connections_limit >= 90; otherwise `ok`. Return only rows where risk_reason is not `ok`, with exactly five columns: database_name, free_percent, connections_used, connections_limit, risk_reason. Sort by reason priority read_only, disk, connections, then database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name, free_percent, connections_used, connections_limit
FROM database_health
hints: One CASE can derive the reason and an outer SELECT can filter by its alias.
CASE branch order matters because one database may satisfy multiple conditions.
solution_explanation: Condition priority makes classification deterministic; an outer query allows filtering the derived risk_reason cleanly.
